subject: Mutual Action Plan: EvalPod technical gateways & close cadence
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Mutual Action Plan: EvalPod technical gateways & close cadence

Hi Emily —

Thanks for the time earlier. As promised, attaching a concise Mutual Action Plan focused on the technical gates we need to clear for the EvalPod (our short POC environment). High-level ask: can you confirm the security and network owners so we can align on the target close date and the VPC peering window?

Key technical gates (summary):
- Org + tenant setup: create a Helix eval org on Redwood console and share owner email for auto-provisioning.
- API keys: one long-lived test key for staging + one ephemeral key for load tests (we supply rotation guidance).
- IP allowlist: list of IP prefixes for your firewall (we provide sample egress policies).
- VPC peering: peering request + CIDR confirmation; we support both static routes and AWS Transit options.

Proposed close cadence (we recommend two-week runway):
Week 0: org & owner invite + API key issuance; exchange of CIDRs and security contacts.
Week 1: networking actions (allowlist + peering request); initial smoke tests.
Week 2: performance validation, KV/cache warm-up, and final sign-off.

Attached: MAP-draft-helix.pdf (one-page technical gates + a proposed timeline).

Can you please: 1) confirm Samir (network/security) as primary for the peering, 2) share the CIDR ranges you want to use, and 3) tell us if there are any procurement constraints that would delay key issuance?

If easier, we can run a short 30-min deep-dive next Tue (11/17) to walk through the peering templates and API key flow.

Thanks —
Priyom
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
redwood.ai

Thanks, this looks reasonable. Looping in Samir (security & infra lead) — Samir, can you confirm the CIDR ranges and whether we need an approval ticket in our change board for peering?

Quick answers from our side:
- I can be the org owner for the eval tenant.
- CIDR ranges: 10.45.0.0/16 for eval; we'll confirm exact subnets once Samir checks routing policy.
- Procurement: nothing blocking, though we prefer a single invoice at POC close — procurement will need the SOW amount.

Samir — any concerns about the timeline? We aim to have EvalPod green by 11/23 if possible.

Best,

Meeting proposal: 30-min technical sync on Tue 11/17 at 10:00 PT to confirm peering fields and hand off the ACL snippets. If that works, I'll send a calendar invite and include the DocuSign SOW URL for procurement reference.

2) Helix to confirm sign-off on Friday 11/23 if perf targets met.
